title: Oil on the Sand

mood.label: Heavy going
mood.summary: Heavy going: a Houthi missile is shot down over Riyadh, tanker attacks leave oil on UAE beaches, Brent hits a four-year high, Europe faces winter short of gas. Small lifts: an Ebola vaccine trial begins, Seoul offers talks, a PTSD trial reports 68% remission.

lines: A light went up over Riyadh,
and the beaches wear the sky.
a church in Jordan, bells gone still,
Queensland's schools shut in the flash.
But a needle finds a Congo arm,
